boasVindas.bolhaResposta: Local families who want a good meal without leaving home.
boasVindas.bolhaConfirma: Great! That goes into your plan.
boasVindas.titulo1: Your business plan, one question at a time
boasVindas.texto1: We guide you through the canvases partners and banks usually ask for — in plain language, no jargon.
boasVindas.gratisItem4: As many businesses as you like
boasVindas.completoTexto: Unlock the other 4 canvases, the analysis with suggestions and the PDF to show a partner or the bank.
boasVindas.completoPreco: One-time payment, for all your businesses
boasVindas.titulo2: Start for free. Unlock the full plan whenever you want.
boasVindas.titulo3: Walk away with a plan that looks professional
boasVindas.texto3: Start with the business name. Stop and come back whenever you like — everything is saved.

negocios.vazioTexto: Start with just the business name. We ask the rest little by little, and you can stop whenever you like.
negocios.pronto: All filled in. Generate the document whenever you like.
negocios.semBanco: This environment does not store data. Run a dev build to create businesses.

novoNegocio.nomeDica: It can be temporary. You can change it later.
novoNegocio.nomeErro: Give the business a name, even a temporary one.
novoNegocio.excluirTexto: This business's answers, numbers and tasks will be erased from this device. This cannot be undone.

ajustes.liberadoTexto: All your businesses have the 4 canvases, the full analysis and the PDF.
ajustes.bloqueadoTexto: Unlock the 4 canvases, the full analysis and the PDF for all your businesses.
ajustes.restaurarDica: Already bought it and changed phones or reinstalled the app?
ajustes.comoFuncionaTexto: Cria puts your answers into a 9-page PDF: cover, summary, diagnosis, the canvases, your ideal customer, the numbers and the action plan. It is all built on this device, with no internet. Generate it again whenever you change an answer.
ajustes.licencaLean: adapted from the Business Model Canvas by Ash Maurya. CC BY-SA 3.0 license.
ajustes.devSimularDica: Development only. Does not talk to the store.
ajustes.devExemploDica: Village Burgers, with the plan's idea and numbers.
ajustes.devSemBanco: No database in this environment: nothing is saved.
ajustes.devSemMmkv: Preferences are in memory only here: they reset on reload.

lean.problema: The neighbourhood only has chain burgers, pricey and slow to deliver.
lean.paraQuem: Families and people working from home, within 3 km.
lean.diferencial: Handmade burgers that arrive hot in 25 minutes.
lean.solucao: Short menu, orders by WhatsApp and our own delivery.
lean.receitas: Burgers and combos; average ticket of $ 32.
lean.custos: Kitchen rent, ingredients, gas, delivery rider.
lean.metricas: Burgers sold per month and customers who return within 30 days.
lean.vantagem: Our own sauce recipe and good ties with the neighbours.
